title: Group policy certificate requirements.
bodyText:
A certificate issued pursuant to a group long-term care insurance policy which is delivered or issued for delivery in this State shall include:

(1) A description of the principal benefits and coverage provided in the policy;

(2) A statement of the principal exclusions, reductions, and limitations contained in the policy; and

(3) A statement that the group master policy determines governing contractual provisions.
bodyHtml:
[§431:10H-113]  Group policy certificate requirements.  A certificate issued pursuant to a group long-term care insurance policy which is delivered or issued for delivery in this State shall include:

     (1)  A description of the principal benefits and coverage provided in the policy;

     (2)  A statement of the principal exclusions, reductions, and limitations contained in the policy; and

     (3)  A statement that the group master policy determines governing contractual provisions. [L 1999, c 93, pt of §2]
